title: ConfirmReceiptToLambdas
description: The response to send_message_to_slack (chat.postMessage). The shared Slack client reads the posted message's ts, which no Lambda uses. Either a success (ok true) or a failure (ok false). A failed call raises Slack's error code (ratelimited is retried later) and nothing but ok and error is read. Only the fields read are described; every other field is allowed and ignored.

error.description: Slack's error code when ok is false, e.g. not_in_channel or ratelimited. A missing or empty code is reported as unknown_error. Never null.
